description: Golden retrieval set for the model-hub knowledge base (D5-3 / W3-6b). Each question names the single doc whose chunk must appear in the top-5 citations; top-1 is reported separately as a discrimination signal, not a gate. Corpus lives in docs/ and is ingested under the loom project.
